# Walters W.88, Book of Hours monkeys and musicians

Monkeys singing, dancing and playing chess, a harpist with a dancing dog and a woman leading a harrow horse, from the margins of Walters Ms. W.88, a Book of Hours of the first quarter of the 14th century, grouped by folio.

Part of [Ducktape Assets](https://github.com/adrian729/ducktape-assets). Set id `walters-w88`, historical, 15 assets.
